title: Formal unramifiedness of a flat finite extension with source depth two on the boundary
statement: Let $L$ be a locally Noetherian scheme and $U\subset L$ an open [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $p:E\to L$ be finite and flat [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism], and suppose its restriction over $U$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Assume $\operatorname{depth}(\mathcal O_{E,z})\geq2$ whenever $p(z)\notin U$ [def-weil-pbc-depth]. Then $p$ is formally unramified [def-weil-pbc-formally-unramified-morphism]. No smoothness or target-depth assumption is made.

proof.text:
Finiteness over the locally Noetherian target makes E locally Noetherian
and p quasi-finite. At z over U the restriction is etale, hence p is formally
unramified at z. Otherwise depth O(E,z) is at least two, so z is not a generic
point of any irreducible component. Every generalization z' specializing to z
with dim O(E,z') = 1 lies over U: outside U the depth bound would contradict
depth bounded by local dimension. Thus p is unramified at every such z'.
Flatness, quasi-finiteness, the nongeneric condition and this dimension-one
unramifiedness are exactly the four hypotheses of 0BJH, which gives etaleness
at z. Consequently p is formally unramified at every source point, and this
property is local on the source. No target boundary depth, smooth family or
fibre density is needed. Empty sources and U = L are included.

from.place: Etaleness of a supplied finite depth-two extension on a smooth local scheme; local boundary extension in the depth-two paragraph of the spreading proof; Formal unramifiedness of a flat finite extension with source depth two on the boundary

lean.statement:
theorem formallyUnramified_of_flat_depth_two_finite_extension
    {L : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (U : L.Opens)
    {E : Scheme.{u}} (p : E ⟶ L) [IsFinite p] [Flat p] [Etale (p ∣_ U)]
    (hboundary : ∀ z : E, p z ∉ U →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := E.presheaf.stalk z) (E.presheaf.stalk z)) :
    FormallyUnramified p
